snippet.title: LE FOL | Latin American Games Showcase SGF 2025 - Trailer
snippet.description:
In a narrative with multiple endings, puzzles and poetry, inspired by the Tarot of Marseille and with neo-impressionist art, explore the life of LE FOL, interacting with the scenarios, Arcana, puzzles and poetry, in a story centered on identity, mental health and human relationships.
